model_annotation: The horizontal bar chart illustrates the Number of Participants associated with various categories. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Criterion," with the text labels ordered from top to bottom in descending order based on their corresponding values. The horizontal axis represents the value, labeled "Number of Participants," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 6 with numeric tick labels and corresponding vertical gridlines placed at intervals of 2. The chart displays seven individual horizontal bars whose colors transition in a gradient from dark purple at the top to yellow-green at the bottom. Each bar is annotated at its right end with a bold number indicating its exact value. The longest bar at the top corresponds to "Relevant FCs" (dark purple, 6), followed by "FC Summary" (dark blue, 5), "Relevance Explanation" (dark teal, 3), "Clarity and Simplicity" (teal, 3), and "Overall Summary" (medium green, 2). The two shortest bars at the bottom represent "Filters" (light green, 1) and "Veracity Explanation" (yellow-green, 1).
